name: joystick_deflection_minimum
label: Joystick center dead zone
description: Center dead zone for the analog stick, as a percent of full travel. Set it high enough to stop a wandering mouse or joystick. This is a separate thing from the D-Pad rings.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py slider_NEUTRAL (0..20) and its tooltip; qsflash.py defaults '8'

name: joystick_deflection_maximum
label: Joystick full deflection
description: How far the stick has to move for a full signal. QMP takes the largest of its four direction sliders.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py slider_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT (10..50) and calculate_joystick_preferences; qsflash.py defaults '25'

name: deflection_multiplier_up
label: Up deflection multiplier
description: Scales the up direction so it reaches a full signal at the same point as the other directions.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py calculate_joystick_preferences computes max*100/slider, so it has no fixed range; qsflash.py defaults '140'

name: deflection_multiplier_down
label: Down deflection multiplier
description: Scales the down direction so it reaches a full signal at the same point as the other directions.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py calculate_joystick_preferences computes max*100/slider, so it has no fixed range; qsflash.py defaults '130'

name: deflection_multiplier_left
label: Left deflection multiplier
description: Scales the left direction so it reaches a full signal at the same point as the other directions.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py calculate_joystick_preferences computes max*100/slider, so it has no fixed range; qsflash.py defaults '100'

name: deflection_multiplier_right
label: Right deflection multiplier
description: Scales the right direction so it reaches a full signal at the same point as the other directions.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py calculate_joystick_preferences computes max*100/slider, so it has no fixed range; qsflash.py defaults '100'

name: joystick_D_Pad_inner
label: Inner D-Pad ring
description: Percent of full deflection, measured from the center, where the inner D-Pad ring starts. It only fires after a short delay, so you can move through it on the way out without triggering it. Half this value is where a direction stops being held.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py slider_D_Pad_inner_ring (10..100) and its tooltip; qsflash.py defaults '25'. Firmware 1476 Configuration.c:306-316 converts it with (value * 1023) / 100, so it is a percent of full deflection from the center, and DataFlow.c:610 uses half of it as the release threshold.

name: joystick_D_Pad_outer
label: Outer D-Pad ring
description: Percent of full deflection, measured from the center, where the outer D-Pad ring starts. Past this line a direction fires straight away.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py slider_D_Pad_outer_ring (10..100) and its tooltip; qsflash.py defaults '80'. Firmware 1476 Preferences.h defaults to 65, but that snapshot is older than QMP-4. Configuration.c:306-316 converts it with (value * 1023) / 100, so it is a percent of full deflection from the center.

name: joystick_dead_zone_shape
label: Circular dead zone
description: Use a round center dead zone instead of a square one.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py checkbox_circular_deadzone writes '1' or '0'; qsflash.py defaults '1'

name: anti_dead_zone
label: Anti dead zone
source: firmware 1476 preference_keywords.h ANTI_DEAD_ZONE, read in DataFlow.c. No current control or range is known, so the value is left as typed.

name: joystick_warning
label: Joystick warning deflection
description: Deflection past which firmware 1476 warns the user about moving the stick too far.
source: firmware 1476 preference_keywords.h JOYSTICK_WARN_DEFLECTION, compared in DataFlow.c. No current control or range is known, so the value is left as typed.

name: joystick_alarm
label: Joystick alarm deflection
description: Deflection past which firmware 1476 sounds an alarm tone.
source: firmware 1476 preference_keywords.h JOYSTICK_ALARM_DEFLECTION, compared in DataFlow.c. No current control or range is known, so the value is left as typed.

name: enable_auto_zero
label: Auto zero the sensors
source: QMP-4 has no control for this setting. Its qsflash.py defaults '0' and QuadStick.py SavePreferences writes '0'; the 0/1 domain comes from the firmware 1476 keyword table, preference_keywords.h ENABLE_AUTO_ZERO. Nothing beyond that shape and that default is sourced.

name: sip_puff_threshold_soft
label: Soft sip/puff threshold
description: Pressure or vacuum level that begins a soft sip or puff.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py slider_SP_low (5..100) and its tooltip; qsflash.py defaults '8'

name: sip_puff_threshold
label: Hard sip/puff threshold
description: Pressure at which to trigger the output.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py slider_SP_high (10..100) and its tooltip; qsflash.py defaults '40'

name: sip_puff_maximum
label: Sip/puff maximum pressure
description: Maximum pressure to scale to a full signal.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py slider_SP_max (10..100) and its tooltip; qsflash.py defaults '70'

name: sip_puff_delay_soft
label: Soft sip/puff delay
description: Soft sip and puff signals are sensed after this short delay.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py spin_ctrl_SP_low_delay (min 100, max 3000) and its tooltip; qsflash.py defaults '1300'

name: sip_puff_delay_hard
label: Hard sip/puff delay
description: How long a hard sip or puff is held before it counts as a long signal.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py spin_ctrl_SP_high_delay (min 1000, max 3000); qsflash.py defaults '2400'. It is absent from firmware 1476 preference_keywords.h, so it is not offered as a mode override.

name: enable_left_side_tube
label: Use the left side tube
description: Uses the left tube for mode control by swapping it with the right tube.
source: firmware 1476 preference_keywords.h ENABLE_LEFT_SIDE_TUBE, read in DataFlow.c. QMP-4 has no control or default for it, so the value is left as typed.

name: lip_position_minimum
label: Lip sensor minimum
description: Percent lip sensor position that activates the signal.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py slider_Lip_min (5..100) and its tooltip; qsflash.py defaults '8'

name: lip_position_maximum
label: Lip sensor maximum
description: Percent of lip sensor movement that gives a full signal.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py slider_Lip_max (5..100) and its tooltip; qsflash.py defaults '35'

name: mouse_speed
label: Mouse speed
description: Mouse speed relative to joystick movement.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py slider_mouse_speed (0..250) and its tooltip; qsflash.py defaults '100'

name: mouse_response_curve
label: Mouse response curve
description: 0 is linear, 1 is mixed, 2 is parabolic.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py choice_mouse_response ['Linear','Mixed','Parabolic'] saved as the chosen index; qsflash.py defaults '1'

name: volume
label: Speaker volume
description: Speaker volume.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py slider_volume (0..100) and its tooltip; qsflash.py defaults '40'. Firmware 1476 Preferences.h defaults to 25, but that snapshot is older than QMP-4.

name: brightness
label: LED brightness
description: LED brightness.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py slider_brightness (0..100) and its tooltip; qsflash.py defaults '75'

name: enable_rumble
label: Rumble
source: firmware 1476 preference_keywords.h ENABLE_RUMBLE, read in Joystick.c. QMP-4 has no control or default for it, so the value is left as typed.

name: bluetooth_device_mode
label: Bluetooth device mode
description: What the QuadStick pretends to be over Bluetooth.
source: firmware 1476 preference_keywords.h bluetooth_device_mode_keywords; QMP-4 QuadStick.py choice_BT_device_mode has the same seven tokens; qsflash.py defaults 'none'

name: bluetooth_authentication_mode
label: Bluetooth authentication mode
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py choice_BT_auth_mode offers 0, 1, 2 and 4; qsflash.py defaults '4'

name: bluetooth_connection_mode
label: Bluetooth connection mode
source: firmware 1476 preference_keywords.h bluetooth_connection_mode_keywords; qsflash.py defaults 'pair'

name: bluetooth_remote_address
label: Bluetooth remote address
source: firmware 1476 preference_keywords.h BLUETOOTH_REMOTE_ADDRESS; QMP-4 qsflash.py defaults to an empty string. No address format is confirmed, so the value is left as typed.

name: bluetooth_remote_adapter
label: Bluetooth remote adapter
source: firmware 1476 preference_keywords.h BLUETOOTH_REMOTE_ADAPTER, read in Joystick.c. QMP-4 has no control or default for it, so the value is left as typed.

name: bluetooth_throttle
label: Bluetooth throttle
description: Firmware 1476 skips a transmission when not enough time has passed since the last one.
source: firmware 1476 preference_keywords.h BLUETOOTH_THROTTLE, compared in Bluetooth.c. No current control or range is known, so the value is left as typed.

name: digital_out_1
label: Digital output 1
description: The device matches this name as an output before it reaches the preference table, so it is a device setting only, never a mode override.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py checkbox_do_1 writes '1' or '0'; qsflash.py defaults '0'; firmware 1476 output_keywords match first

name: digital_out_2
label: Digital output 2
description: The device matches this name as an output before it reaches the preference table, so it is a device setting only, never a mode override.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py checkbox_do_2 writes '1' or '0'; qsflash.py defaults '0'; firmware 1476 output_keywords match first

name: digital_out_3
label: Digital output 3
description: The device matches this name as an output before it reaches the preference table, so it is a device setting only, never a mode override.
source: firmware 1476 preference_keywords.h DIGITAL_OUT_3. QMP-4 has no control or default for it, so the value is left as typed.

name: digital_out_4
label: Digital output 4
description: The device matches this name as an output before it reaches the preference table, so it is a device setting only, never a mode override.
source: firmware 1476 preference_keywords.h DIGITAL_OUT_4. QMP-4 has no control or default for it, so the value is left as typed.

name: enable_swap_inputs
label: Swap inputs with the side tube
description: Swap the inputs using the side tube.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py checkbox_swap writes '1' or '0'; qsflash.py defaults '0'. Firmware 1476 Preferences.h defaults to 1, but that snapshot is older than QMP-4.

name: enable_select_files
label: Select files with the side tube
description: Select a file using the side tube.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py checkbox_select_files writes '1' or '0'; qsflash.py defaults '1'

name: enable_usb_a_device
label: USB-A device mode
risk: This picks which USB port the QuadStick presents itself on. Firmware 1476 reconnects USB when it changes, so a wrong value can leave the device unseen by a console or computer. QMP writes a different name, enable_usb_a_host, and the two are not proven to be the same setting. Change it only on advice from QuadStick support.
source: firmware 1476 preference_keywords.h ENABLE_USB_A_DEVICE, passed to USB_Init and USB_Connect in Joystick.c and Configuration.c; QMP-4 QuadStick.py writes enable_usb_a_host instead

name: enable_DS3_emulation
label: USB emulation mode
risk: The name says DS3, but firmware 1476 reads it as a USB emulation mode with several numbered values, not an on or off switch. The current value map is not confirmed, so QCM keeps whatever is typed and claims nothing about it. Change it only on advice from QuadStick support.
source: firmware 1476 preference_keywords.h maps it to USB_EMULATION_MODE, switched on in Joystick.c, DataFlow.c and Descriptors.c; QMP-4 QuadStick.py checkbox_ps4_boot_mode treats it as a checkbox

name: enable_usb_comm
label: Voice commands over USB
description: Enable voice commands over USB.
source: QMP-4 QuadStick.py checkbox_enable_usb_comm writes '1' or '0'; qsflash.py defaults '0'

name: watchdog_disable
label: Disable the watchdog
risk: Firmware 1476 runs a two minute hardware watchdog that restarts the device if it stops responding. Nothing in that snapshot reads this setting, so what it does on current firmware is unconfirmed.
source: QMP-4 qsflash.py defaults '0'; firmware 1476 preference_keywords.h DISABLE_WATCHDOG and the watchdog set up in Joystick.c

name: debug
label: Debug output level
description: Firmware 1476 turns its console on when this is above zero.
source: firmware 1476 preference_keywords.h DEBUG_VERBOSITY, read in Configuration.c. It is a level, not an on or off, so the value is left as typed.
